source_name: PCPartsPicker component categories reference (third-party wiki page)
ladder: CPU > Motherboard > Memory > Graphics card > Storage > Case > Power supply > CPU cooler > Case fans > Optical drive > Operating system
facets: CPU line (i5/i7/i9, Ryzen 5/7/9); socket; memory type DDR4/DDR5, speed, capacity; GPU maker; storage NVMe/SATA/HDD; form factor; wattage
notes: Part-type ladder with automatic cross-part compatibility check; compatibility (socket, form factor) is a check, not a level.

ladder: 80 Plus > Bronze > Silver > Gold > Platinum > Titanium > Ruby
quality_signals: 80 PLUS tiers (voluntary programme, run by CLEAResult; test protocol from EPRI and Ecos)
notes: Power supplies sorted by recognised efficiency grade; thresholds vary by voltage and category.

ladder: hardware, software, electronics, household, sports, drugstore > product category > filters
facets: about 150 filters on notebooks: USB port count and version, operating system version, time on market
quality_signals: editorial specification sheets, test reports, user ratings, price history, trader ratings
notes: Austrian comparison site; filters set by an editorial board; ladder second-hand from encyclopaedia, not the site itself.

ladder: device type (multimedia, office, subnotebook, gaming, workstation, smartphone, tablet, convertible) > weighted categories
quality_markers: case; keyboard; pointing device; connectivity; weight; battery; display; gaming performance; system performance; workstation performance; temperature; system noise; audio; camera
quality_signals: own percentage score, bands Insufficient 0-49, Sufficient 50-62, Satisfactory 63-74, Good 75-87, Excellent 88-100; price excluded
notes: German reviewer; weights differ by device use; reviewer may adjust by impression.

ladder: switch technology (membrane, metal contact, reed, capacitive, Hall effect, optical, buckling spring) > keycaps and stabilizers
facets: hot-swap; Hall effect adjustable actuation; diodes against ghosting
quality_signals: Cherry MX colour code widely copied
notes: Switch mechanism is the main split; Cherry MX is the reference naming system.

ladder: Community / Featured / By Brand / By Product Category (DACs and amplifiers; headphones and audio sources; lifestyle and desk incl. mechanical keyboards, keycaps, deskmats)
quality_markers: preferred feedback (linear, tactile, clicky); place of use and noise; upkeep and lubing
notes: Shop offers By Brand and By Category side by side; says switch choice is preference, not rank.
Japanese comparison site page gave no category detail; Chinese and Japanese retail trees not obtained (hosts blocked or rate-limited).

source_name: Digital Trends cell phone buying guide
ladder: price range > features needed > operating system > specs > carrier > service plan
quality_markers: OLED screen; processor over RAM; latest OS version and update support; storage 64GB; durability; battery by review not mAh; camera more than megapixels
notes: Dated 2023; budget first, then use, then platform.

source_name: Digital Unite how to choose a smartphone
ladder: memory > camera > GPS > apps > dexterity > ease of use > tinkering > budget > purchase
quality_markers: fit to needs; camera; app range; ease of use; price
notes: UK older-user charity guide; defines best as fit to need, no spec ranking.

ladder: overall score > photo and video > sub-scores
quality_markers: exposure; colour; autofocus; texture; noise; artifacts; night; zoom; bokeh; wide; preview
quality_signals: DXOMARK Camera (photo, video, selfie), also audio, display, battery scores
notes: French lab score; method commercially secret; image quality only; firm also consults for makers.

source_name: Notebookcheck Our Rating Criteria (smartphone and tablet columns)
ladder: device type > weighted categories
quality_markers: weight 18; pointing device 16; battery 16; display 12; camera 8 (smartphone weights, 2016 table)
quality_signals: percentage score with bands from Insufficient to Excellent
notes: Phones weigh handling, battery and display above processor and camera.

source_name: World Wide Stereo how to choose headphones
ladder: use (travel, home, gym) > type over-ear/on-ear/in-ear > closed or open back > wired or wireless > noise cancelation > accessories
facets: type; back design; connection; noise cancelling
quality_markers: over-ear drivers give space; open back more spacious; wired consistent signal; trusted brand and authorised dealer
notes: US specialist retailer; type is called the biggest decision.

source_name: The Absolute Sound review of Sennheiser HD 800
ladder: review > scorecard
quality_markers: tonal balance; clarity; dynamics; comfort and fit; sensitivity; value; soundstage
quality_signals: magazine scorecard per criterion, compared with similarly priced headphones
notes: High-end magazine; ranks tonal balance and clarity first.

ladder: By Brand / By Product Category (DACs and amplifiers; headphones and audio sources; lifestyle)
notes: Audiophile shop groups amplifiers and DACs apart from headphones.

ladder: Best: headphones > noise cancelling > wireless earbuds > noise cancelling earbuds > gaming > over-ear > wireless > running > Apple > PC gaming ...
facets: use (gaming, running, music, working out); form (over-ear, in-ear, on-ear, earbuds); connection; platform (Xbox, PS5, Android, Apple)
quality_signals: lab measured scores by usage; test bench
notes: Only the menu was fetched; test body not read. Lists mix form and use.

quality_signals: DXOMARK audio playback and recording, display, wireless speaker tests
notes: Same lab rates speakers and displays.

source_name: Apos Audio guide and Absolute Sound HD 800 review
facets: neutral, warm, bright sound signatures; amplifier pairing
notes: Enthusiast talk: reviews describe sound signature and amp pairing rather than country.

ladder: budget table > five factors > camera type (DSLR, mirrorless, Micro Four Thirds, compact, bridge, action) > price > image quality > size > sensor size > lens type > speed > video > brands > resolution
facets: sensor size; fixed or interchangeable lens; type
quality_markers: larger sensor; pixel size over megapixels; lens; skill over body
notes: Says brand does not affect image quality; lens availability weighs heavily.

ladder: genre and goals > analog or digital > interchangeable or fixed lens > DSLR or mirrorless > technical features
facets: film or digital; lens system; body type
quality_markers: sensor size best indicator; resolution with pixel size; lens quality; build and long-term support
notes: US specialist retailer; starts from what you photograph.

source_name: Digital Trends digital camera buying guide
ladder: budget and need > type (point-and-shoot, mirrorless, DSLR) > features
facets: sensor format (Micro Four Thirds, APS-C, full frame); viewfinder; stabilisation; weatherproofing
quality_markers: sensor size; lens most important; stabilisation for video
notes: Asks first whether a phone is enough at low budget.

ladder: sensor score; lens score
quality_markers: colour depth; dynamic range; low light; sharpness; distortion; vignetting; transmission; chromatic aberration
quality_signals: DXOMARK sensor score and lens score
notes: Lab scores for bodies and lenses; secret weighting.

source_name: Steam store browsing (via GameDiscover deep dive)
ladder: genre category pages > theme > player mode > individual tags; New and Noteworthy separate
facets: genre (e.g. Grand and 4X Strategy); theme (Horror, Sci-Fi); player support (co-op, MMO)
notes: Human-curated category pages built from user tags, three entry dimensions.

ladder: Menu > Search > Add search filters
notes: 3DS-era page; filters reached through search.

ladder: Discover > charts > Recent releases > Current offers
facets: software or DLC; price range; genre; age rating; demos; publisher
quality_markers: user reviews, sort by score wanted
notes: Poll of buyers: filters wanted most; complaints of shovelware and no basket.

ladder: Games > platform (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Sega, SNK, PC Engine, WonderSwan, misc) ; Hardware > same platforms ; Categories
facets: search by publisher; budget under 12 pounds; pre-order; recommended
notes: Japanese import shop leads with platform, then games versus hardware; publisher search offered.

ladder: Metascore 0-100 weighted critic average
quality_signals: Metascore bands 90-100 Universal acclaim; 75-89 favorable; 50-74 mixed; 20-49 unfavorable; 0-19 dislike
notes: Weights per critic undisclosed.

ladder: E > E10+ > T > M > AO
quality_signals: ESRB age ratings (self-regulatory, set by at least three raters); IARC automated for some
notes: Age rating, not quality; PEGI not fetched.

ladder: Action > Adventure > Digital tabletop > Puzzle > Role-playing > Simulation > Sports > Vehicle > Strategy
notes: Genre is by how it is played; one game may have several genres.
